data.title: Assistant Business Development Manager (Agency Force)
data.description: Responsibilities: Manage small to medium-scale of agency portfolios and maintain strong relationships and rapport with agents through frequent interaction Contribute to the sales channel practices to improve agent’s productivity and efficiency Be involved with sales and marketing activities to increase submission activities and sales penetration Support cross-sell and up-sell business opportunities Improve sales penetration through such marketing initiatives Assist agents to map out production goals and strategies Track and monitor agents’ performances and to recommend appropriate solutions if they encounter difficulties. Promote training to increase agents’ product proficiency and enhance skills set Execute recruitment strategies and plans for growing the sales force Support company’s promotion, publicity and bulletin materials and carry out the launch of campaigns. Work with internal department to ensure quality service and underwriting/product standards are maintained Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field; MBA is a plus A minimum of 5 years experience in business development, sales, or strategic partnership roles Strong understanding of the industry and market dynamics Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills Results-oriented with a track record of achieving or exceeding targets Candidate with Mainland China background, especially in insurance industry is highly preferred About AXA Hong Kong and Ma

data.title: Manager, Distribution Projects (3 years contract)
data.description: About the Role: This role supports the development and execution of strategic distribution initiatives that enhance customer engagement and business growth. Working closely with cross-functional business teams and distribution management, you will help translate business strategies into practical frontline solutions, drive adoption of digital capabilities, ensuring initiatives are implemented effectively and deliver sustainable business value and positive customer outcomes. Major Responsibilities: Partner with business stakeholders and distribution management to translate customer and business initiatives into practical solutions that can be effectively adopted by frontline distribution teams. Coordinate the planning and delivery of distributor-facing digital solutions, ensuring alignment with business processes, customer journeys and frontline needs. Develop playbooks, engagement approaches and communication materials to support the successful rollout of strategic initiatives and enhance customer engagement. Drive engagement and change adoption through structured communications, training and activation activities. Monitor adoption, usage and engagement metrics to identify opportunities for continuous improvement and improved business outcomes. Gather frontline feedback and customer insights to continuously enhance business initiatives, digital capabilities and the overall customer and distributor experience. Qualifications: Degree holder in Business Administration, Marketing
